newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Stampede at Zaire soccer ground kills two.
newsitem.headline: Stampede at Zaire soccer ground kills two.

text.p: A stampede killed at least two people during a soccer match at Zaire's national stadium on Sunday, witnesses said.
The stampede followed a disputed goal during a match between Zairean rivals Vita Club and DCMP, the witnesses added.
Witnesses said soldiers fired teargas into the crowd after a pitch invasion when DCMP disputed a second Vita Club goal.
Vita Club of Kinshasa were leading 1-0 before the incident occurred.
